Figure 6.1 Simplified stress block for concrete at ULS

In BS8110: Part 1, the ultimate concrete strain ¢,, for the flexural design of

normal strength conerete is taken as a constant yalue of 0.0035. Research by
hoth the UK Concrete Society and The University of Hong Kong has shown that
the ductility of concrete decreases with higher concrete strength. Hence, the
ultimate concrete strain needs to be reduced as the concrete strength increases.
The limitation on strain in Figure 6.1 is based on the research by The University
of Hong Kong, as published in the following paper.

Ho J.C.M., Kwan A-K.H, and Pam H.J., “Ultimate conerete strain and equivalent
rectangular stress block for design of high-strength concrete beams”, Structural
Engineer, Vol.80, No.16, 2002, pp26-32.
